missing: A head-to-head of only the retractable-cable laptop banks (Anker 25K 165W, Anker Prime 26K 300W, Ugreen Nexode 20K 165W, Sharge 25K, ReelPro) on cable wattage, cable length and retract durability, real MacBook/laptop charge counts, and current prices.
why: Four major reviewers with their own testing (WIRED, Engadget and its Yahoo syndication, Macworld, 9to5Mac) all feature retractable-cable laptop power banks as named picks with specs and prices; Engadget/Yahoo's best overall is exactly a retractable-cable 100W+ bank. A new page could not displace them; the only gap is a retractable-only comparison rather than a general laptop-bank guide.
